name: Iwane Chiaki
source:
Best friend's mother.

She is a married woman who works hard and does her housework perfectly. She loves her family more than anything else.

Her personality is cheerful and outspoken, but she is kind to the younger generation and the weak. However, she is not infinitely kind, and when she is angry, she gets very angry.

[From [url=http://plum.sakura.ne.jp/~tabito/g_hp3/game3.html]official site[/url]]
